nodes.title: SG-6.1.4 Reconcile character tests with schema, validation and BootScene source
nodes.body:
Context: character tests exist in game/tests/characterSchema.test.ts, game/tests/validator.test.ts and game/frontend/tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts. They are reported as passing. Desired behavior: each suite asserts observable behavior of characterSchema (game/src/content/schema.ts), validateWorld (game/src/content/loader.ts) and BootScene character wiring (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts). Expected result: removing the code under test makes the matching test fail. Why: passing tests that do not exercise the source give false confidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the characterSchema tests, when characterSchema defaults, required idle animation or interaction handling is removed, then at least one test in game/tests/characterSchema.test.ts fails
- Given the validateWorld tests, when the scene character check is removed from validateWorld, then a test in game/tests/validator.test.ts fails
- Given the BootScene character tests, when createCharacter or the shutdown cleanup is removed, then a test in game/frontend/tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts fails


## Scope
- In scope: Test assertions for characterSchema, validateWorld scene characters and BootScene character wiring
- Out of scope: New character features
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Browser or e2e testing
- Preserve: Existing public exports of schema.ts, loader.ts and BootScene.ts
- Preserve: Existing passing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays mocked via vi.mock in BootScene tests
- Tests use zod and the real source modules, never mocks of the code under test


## Definition of done
- All three requirements have an Act and a Verify unit
- Evidence ticket confirms the three test files pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · characterSchema tests assert real parsing, defaults and rejection
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/content/schema.ts L47-L60 defines characterInteractionSchema and characterSchema with scale default 1, layer default 'characters', required idle animation and optional interaction. The current tests cover only interaction. Desired behavior: tests also assert defaults, required idle and invalid values. Expected result: removing any of these schema rules fails a test. Why: the schema is the content contract for NPCs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a character without scale and layer, when parsed, then scale equals 1 and layer equals 'characters'
- Given a character without animations.idle, when parsed, then parsing throws
- Given a character with scale 0 or a negative scale, when parsed, then parsing throws


## Scope
- In scope: characterSchema defaults and rejection rules
- Out of scope: Scene schema
- Out of scope: Loader
- Preserve: Optional interaction behavior


## Technical constraints
- Tests run with vitest from game/ using in-memory input only


## Definition of done
- Schema behavior covered by tests that depend on the real characterSchema


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · validateWorld scene character tests assert exact path-tagged errors
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/content/loader.ts L142-L146 reports 'scenes[<id>].characters[<i>].id: unknown character <id>'. Desired behavior: tests assert the exact message, the index and absence of errors when characters are undefined or valid. Expected result: removing the check fails a test. Why: dangling character references must be caught at load time.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with an unknown character at index 1, when validateWorld runs, then the errors contain 'scenes[bedroom].characters[1].id: unknown character ghost'
- Given a scene with no characters field, when validateWorld runs, then no character error is reported
- Given one unknown scene character, when validateWorld runs, then exactly one error is reported


## Scope
- In scope: validateWorld scene characters branch
- Out of scope: Dialogue speaker checks
- Preserve: Existing error strings


## Technical constraints
- Tests build LoadedWorld objects in memory


## Definition of done
- Check covered by tests that fail without it


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene character tests assert spawn, click, fallback and cleanup
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts create (L66-L82) and createCharacter (L103-L124) spawn sprites, emit characterClick and destroy sprites on shutdown. Current tests cover spawn, interact and click. Desired behavior: tests also cover no characters, missing interact fallback and shutdown destroy. Expected result: removing that code fails a test. Why: Phaser cleanup and click wiring must be proven.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene without characters, when create runs, then add.sprite is not called
- Given the SHUTDOWN callback registered via events.once, when invoked, then every character sprite destroy is called
- Given a character without an interact animation, when pointerdown fires, then characterClick is emitted and no other animation plays


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene character wiring tests
- Out of scope: Real Phaser rendering
- Preserve: Existing three tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays mocked
- Run with the frontend vitest config


## Definition of done
- Behaviors covered by tests that fail without the code


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.symbol: new: it('destroys character sprites on shutdown')
steps.action: Create BootScene, call create(), find the call in boot.events.once whose first arg is 'shutdown', invoke its second arg, and assert the sprite destroy spy was called once.
steps.code: const cb = (boot.events.once as any).mock.calls.find((c: unknown[]) => c[0] === 'shutdown')[1]; cb(); expect(sprite.destroy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts -t "shutdown"
steps.expected: Test passes; it fails if the shutdown destroy loop is removed.

steps.symbol: new: it('creates no sprite when the scene has no characters')
steps.action: Set scene.characters to [] before new BootScene().create(), assert boot.add.sprite was not called, then restore the original array in finally.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts -t "no characters"
steps.expected: Test passes; it fails if create ignores scene.characters.

steps.symbol: new: it('only emits characterClick when the character has no interact animation')
steps.action: Delete animations.interact from the mocked scene character, create the scene, fire pointerdown via pointerDownOn, assert emit called with characterClick {id:'boy'} and play not called after mockClear; restore in finally.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass.
